import os, re

        # check if file is exact repetition

        if not ok:
            print("ANOMALY:", p, len(data), oct(os.stat(p).st_mode & 0o777))
EOF

import os, re

        if not ok:

EOF

import os, re

        # check if file is exact repetition

        if not ok:
            print("ANOMALY:", p, len(data), oct(os.stat(p).st_mode & 0o777))
EOF

import os, re

        p = os.path.join(recdir, item)

        m = re.match(rb'^item(\d+)$', item.encode() if isinstance(item,str) else item)
        ii = item[4:]

        # check if file is exact repetition

        ok = all(data[k:k+n]==expected_unit for k in range(0,len(data),n)) and len(data)%n==0
        if not ok:
            print("ANOMALY:", p, len(data), oct(os.stat(p).st_mode & 0o777))
EOF

import os, re
for area in sorted(os.listdir('.')):
    recdir = os.path.join(area, '.records')
    for item in sorted(os.listdir(recdir)):
        p = os.path.join(recdir, item)
        data = open(p,'rb').read()
        an = area  # e.g. area00
        m = re.match(rb'^item(\d+)$', item.encode() if isinstance(item,str) else item)
        ii = item[4:]
        expected_unit = f"record {an[4:]}-{ii}\n".encode()
        # check if file is exact repetition
        n = len(expected_unit)
        ok = all(data[k:k+n]==expected_unit for k in range(0,len(data),n)) and len(data)%n==0
        if not ok:
            print("ANOMALY:", p, len(data), oct(os.stat(p).st_mode & 0o777))
EOF

import os, re
for area in sorted(os.listdir('.')):
    recdir = os.path.join(area, '.records')
    for item in sorted(os.listdir(recdir)):
        p = os.path.join(recdir, item)
        data = open(p,'rb').read()
        an = area  # e.g. area00
        m = re.match(rb'^item(\d+)$', item.encode() if isinstance(item,str) else item)
        ii = item[4:]
        expected_unit = f"record {an[4:]}-{ii}\n".encode()
        # check if file is exact repetition
        n = len(expected_unit)
        ok = all(data[k:k+n]==expected_unit for k in range(0,len(data),n)) and len(data)%n==0
        if not ok:
            print("ANOMALY:", p, len(data), oct(os.stat(p).st_mode & 0o777))
EOF
